description: Manually check every required_evidence snippet against the source document before using results in a report.

cases.question: What is the default temporary VPN access duration and what exception can extend it?

required_evidence.text: Temporary VPN access expires after 14 calendar days unless renewed.
Employees assigned to a documented high-priority incident may receive one seven-day extension.
The exception applies only after the service owner approves the extension.

cases.question: Which information must be recorded for an extension, and is a ticket ID by itself enough?

required_evidence.text: Every extension record must include the ticket identifier, the approver's role, the approval date, and the revised expiry date.
A ticket identifier without an approval record is not sufficient evidence that an extension was authorized.

cases.question: Compare the initial access duration for a student contractor and a staff engineer.

required_evidence.text: Student contractor | 7 calendar days | Faculty sponsor
Staff engineer | 14 calendar days | Service owner

cases.question: What sensitive values must support logs omit, and when does the 30-day retention period start?

required_evidence.text: Support logs must omit passwords, API keys and session cookies.
Sanitized diagnostic logs are retained for 30 days, measured from the date the incident is closed.
